# Qt Advanced Docking System

- Upstream: https://github.com/githubuser0xFFFF/Qt-Advanced-Docking-System
- Version: **5.1.1**, tag `v5.1.1`
- Commit: `023ce95934fecfd4cf5c672c9c404fabe0f54923`
- License: LGPL-2.1-or-later; original license is retained in `LICENSE.txt`.
- Windows artifacts: x64, Qt **6.9.3 MSVC2022**, MSVC v143, shared CRT
  (`/MD` Release and `/MDd` Debug).

The public headers in `Ksword5.1/Ksword5.1/include/ads/` are from this
upstream tag. `ads_version.h` is generated by the upstream CMake build.
The import libraries and DLLs are in `Ksword5.1/Ksword5.1/lib/`.
The main project's `CopyQtAdvancedDockingRuntime` target copies the matching
DLL to the executable's output directory after a build.

`build/CMakeLists.txt` preserves the existing `qtadvanceddocking.dll` and
`qtadvanceddockingd.dll` filenames using CMake `OUTPUT_NAME`, so the import
libraries and deployed DLL names agree. Upstream source is otherwise unmodified.
Do not simply rename an upstream DLL: its import library would still reference
the upstream filename.

## Rebuild

Run from the repository root with a Windows CMake installation and MSVC v143.
Set `$env:KSWORD_QT_DIR` to the project's Qt 6.9.3 MSVC2022 installation.

```powershell
$sourceRoot = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.deps/QtADS-5.1.1-source'
$buildRoot = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.deps/QtADS-5.1.1-build'
git clone https://github.com/githubuser0xFFFF/Qt-Advanced-Docking-System.git $sourceRoot
git -C $sourceRoot checkout --detach 023ce95934fecfd4cf5c672c9c404fabe0f54923
cmake -S third_party/qt_advanced_docking_system/build -B $buildRoot `
  -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' -A x64 `
  "-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$env:KSWORD_QT_DIR" "-DKSWORD_ADS_SOURCE_DIR=$sourceRoot"
cmake --build $buildRoot --config Release --target qtadvanceddocking-qt6
cmake --build $buildRoot --config Debug --target qtadvanceddocking-qt6
```

Copy `src/*.h` from the pinned source and `upstream/src/ads_version.h` from
the build into `include/ads/`. Copy the DLLs from `x64/bin/{Release,Debug}/`
and the corresponding `.lib` files from `x64/lib/{Release,Debug}/` into the
main project's `lib/`, then rebuild the application. Preserve the license.
The legacy MinGW `libqtadvanceddocking.a` is not used by this MSVC project.

## KSword integration

Set `CDockManager::DisableStylesheet` **before constructing the manager**.
KSword provides its own application QSS and palette. ADS 5.x defaults to
following palette changes and can otherwise reload its default stylesheet
after KSword has cleared it. Check theme switching, transparent backgrounds,
custom tab factories, floating docks, auto-hide and saved-layout restoration
when upgrading again.
